items.name: utils
items.description: The cn() class-name helper every component uses.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: The whole token layer as one stylesheet: colors, radius, spacing, type, shadows, cursors, light and dark.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: The kit icon set (Boxicons, MIT), named by purpose so it can be swapped in one place.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Scopes an appearance and token overrides to a subtree.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button in semantic variants, appearances and sizes; renders a link with href, and any element with render.

items.name: input-field
items.title: Input field
items.description: Internal: the label (with an optional info note), helper text, validation and field box shared by Field, Text Input, Textarea, Search, Number Input, Select and Combobox.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: Single-line text field with label, helper text, validation, prefix and suffix, add-ons and buttons inside the field, on Base UI Field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, required mark, info note and helper text with validation for a control that has none of its own, on Base UI Field.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Horizontal or vertical separator line, solid or dashed, in several thicknesses.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Count or dot that flags something new, inline or floating on another element.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Key cap that shows which key to press, alone or as a combination.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Round picture of a person with initials and user-icon fallbacks, neutral or any accent hue in subtle or solid, an optional presence dot, and a group that overlaps them with a +n for the rest and optional name tooltips.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: Short status or category label, status and hue variants and appearances, with an optional remove button.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: Button that stays pressed, on Base UI Toggle; neutral when off, the variant when on.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: A selection control on Base UI Toggle Group: ToggleButtons with exactly one on, set apart with a small gap or joined into one bar.

items.name: choice-field
items.title: Choice field
items.description: Internal: the label, helper text and validation wiring shared by Checkbox, Radio and Switch.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch with label and helper text, on Base UI Switch and Field.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with label, helper text and indeterminate state, on Base UI Checkbox and Field.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Radio group from a flat options list, with legend and helper text, on Base UI Radio Group, Field and Fieldset.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface for related content: elevated, outline or unstyled, in sizes xs and sm; a button with onClick or a link with render.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text field with auto-size, rows and resize, on the shared input field.

items.name: search
items.title: Search
items.description: Search field with icon and clear button; Escape clears in every browser, and an optional key such as / focuses it.

items.name: resend-button
items.title: Resend button
items.description: Internal: the small Resend code / Resend link button shared by OTP Input and the auth templates, disabled with a countdown while it cools down; a failed send starts no cooldown.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time code entry, one cell per character, with optional grouping and a resend button with cooldown, on Base UI OTP Field.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with a Show / Hide button named after its label, hidden again when the form is sent, and optional rules for a new password, ticked off as the reader types; on Text Input.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Number field with stepper buttons, limits and precision, on Base UI Number Field.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One option from a list that opens below the field, on Base UI Select.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter a list and choose one option, with match highlighting, on Base UI Combobox.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator: a status, or a progress ring with a value; delay keeps fast loads from flashing it.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Linear progress on Base UI Progress: determinate or indeterminate, with an optional label and value.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Decorative placeholder in the shape of loading content: circle, square or rounded, with rows.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline or standalone link with colour, size, underline, external and disabled states; render prop for router links.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Page or section message in info, success, warning or danger, subtle/outlined/solid, with optional title, action, close button and live announcement.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What an empty list, table or page shows: icon, title as a real heading, description and next action, at a compact or roomy size.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short inverted label on hover or focus, with side and delay, on Base UI Tooltip; TooltipGroup shares the delay.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored dialog panel with title, description and close button, modal or not, on Base UI Popover.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Centred dialog with title, description, scrolling body and footer, or an alert dialog for decisions, on Base UI Dialog and Alert Dialog.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Alert dialog that asks before a destructive action: warning icon, the action as a question, its consequence, Cancel with focus, a destructive button, and optional type-to-confirm, on Modal.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown of actions, links, checkbox and radio items, groups and submenus from an items array, on Base UI Menu.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Row of menus as in a desktop app, File, Edit, View, each opening a Menu flyout, with arrow-key movement along the bar, on Base UI Menubar.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation trail with the current page marked, collapsible middle and router-friendly links.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Previous, next and a stable range of page numbers with ellipses, as buttons or links, with an optional rows summary and rows-per-page select.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Underline or pill tabs with a sliding indicator, icons, vertical orientation and panels, on Base UI Tabs.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Corner notifications with variants, action, timeout, promise and swipe to dismiss: ToastProvider plus useToast(), on Base UI Toast.

items.name: inline-alert
items.title: Inline Alert
items.description: One-line message in the flow of a form or section: icon, text in the variant's colour, optional action and live announcement.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: What a list, panel or page shows when loading failed: Empty State in the danger tone, with details and a live announcement.

items.name: success-state
items.title: Success State
items.description: What a finished flow shows: Empty State in the success tone, with the next step as its action.

items.name: collapse
items.title: Collapse
items.description: One show/hide section with a text-button trigger, changing label and find-in-page support, on Base UI Collapsible.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value or range slider with label, formatted value, per-thumb names and vertical orientation, on Base UI Slider.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress through ordered steps, horizontal or vertical, with complete/current/upcoming/error states and optional back navigation. A bullets appearance shows only the current step's label over a row of dots, for narrow spaces.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Star rating on native radios, interactive or read-only with fractional stars, sizes and custom value text.

items.name: column-chooser
items.title: Column Chooser
items.description: Button that opens a popover listing a table's columns, each with a checkbox to show or hide it, the row header locked, and a Reset to the default set.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Native table with captions, row headers, sortable columns (aria-sort), row selection, expandable rows, a row actions menu, a total row, resizable columns, sticky header and an empty state.

items.name: charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Line, area, bar (stacked or grouped) and pie or donut charts in SVG, plus Sparkline and ChartLegend. Coloured by the --color-chart tokens, with a crosshair tooltip, legend toggles and a table view.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid with full keyboard support, min/max and disabled days, today and locale-aware weeks, on Intl with no date library.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date and date range fields that take typed dates in the locale's order and open a Calendar in a popover, with optional range presets; submit ISO dates.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A hex field with a Figma-style popover picker: saturation/brightness area, hue and opacity strips, Hex/RGB/HSL/HSB fields and swatches. Also exports ColorPanel.

items.name: file-uploader
items.title: File Uploader
items.description: Drop zone and Choose button over a native file input, with type/size/count checks, a file list, and per-file progress or errors.
